# Checkbox Group

Provides shared state to a series of checkboxes.

Exports from `uiofcraft` and `uiofcraft/checkbox-group`: `CheckboxGroup`, `CheckboxGroupPrimitive`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from "uiofcraft"
import { CheckboxGroup } from "uiofcraft"
```

```tsx
<CheckboxGroup>
  <Label>
    <Checkbox defaultChecked />
    Next.js
  </Label>
  <Label>
    <Checkbox />
    Vite
  </Label>
  <Label>
    <Checkbox />
    Astro
  </Label>
</CheckboxGroup>
```

## API Reference

### CheckboxGroup

Styled wrapper for `CheckboxGroup` from Base UI. Provides shared state management for a group of checkboxes with flex column layout.
